$comment: qops hooks. Wired per ADR-0001, which measured every event below. Commands invoke `qops <verb>` and nothing else; every project specific lives in .qops/config.yml. Invoked as `python -m qops` because a bare `qops` resolves in neither cmd.exe nor git-bash without a PATH edit, and a PATH edit is a machine fact that does not belong in a committed file.

permissions.$comment: Waiting on CI is the same five read-only commands every PR. They are machine-independent, so they belong here and not in settings.local.json.
